answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by tying voting weight to a scarce, attested copper stamp that must sit in a personally keyed vault for a full epoch before it vests. Each stamp is minted only after a unique work receipt is published and countersigned; cloned accounts cannot share one stamp because the vault binds it to a single key. If a later audit shows two identities used the same receipt, the stamp is destroyed and only an ember of slashed, non-transferable history remains, warning attesters to ignore both keys.
